class Writer()
    int[] bytes := []
    buffer := 0
    pending := 0
    padding_bits := 0
    stuffed_bytes := 0

    void .write(int value, int width)
        shift := width - 1
        while shift >= 0
            buffer = 2 * buffer + (value / (2 ^ shift)) % 2
            pending += 1
            if pending == 8
                bytes = bytes.append(buffer)
                if buffer == 255
                    bytes = bytes.append(0)
                    stuffed_bytes += 1
                buffer = 0
                pending = 0
            shift -= 1

    void .pad()
        if pending != 0
            width := 8 - pending
            padding_bits += width
            .write(2 ^ width - 1, width)

    void .restart(int number)
        .pad()
        bytes = bytes.concat([255, 208 + number % 8])

class Reader(int[] bytes, int position)
    buffer := 0
    remaining := 0
    fault := ""

    int .bit()
        if fault != ""
            return -1
        if remaining == 0
            value := bytes[position]
            if value == 255
                if bytes[position + 1] != 0
                    fault = "marker"
                    return -1
                position += 2
            else
                position += 1
            buffer = value
            remaining = 8
        remaining -= 1
        return (buffer / (2 ^ remaining)) % 2

    int .read(int width)
        value := 0
        for: i < width
            next := .bit()
            if fault != ""
                return -1
            value = 2 * value + next
        return value

    void .discard()
        buffer = 0
        remaining = 0

int find_resync(int[] bytes, int position)
    for: position <= offset < int(#bytes) - 1
        next := bytes[offset + 1]
        if bytes[offset] == 255 and ((next >= 208 and next <= 215) or next == 217)
            return offset
    return int(#bytes) - 2

int floor_div(int numerator, int denominator)
    quotient := numerator / denominator
    if numerator < 0 and numerator % denominator != 0
        quotient -= 1
    return quotient

int clamp(int value)
    return if value < 0 then 0 elif value > 255 then 255 else value

int[] to_ycbcr(int[] pixel)
    red := pixel[0]
    green := pixel[1]
    blue := pixel[2]
    return [(19595 * red + 38470 * green + 7471 * blue + 32768) / 65536,
        floor_div(-11059 * red - 21709 * green + 32768 * blue + 8421375, 65536),
        floor_div(32768 * red - 27439 * green - 5329 * blue + 8421375, 65536)]

int[] to_rgb(int y, int cb, int cr)
    return [clamp(y + floor_div(91881 * (cr - 128) + 32768, 65536)),
        clamp(y + floor_div(-22554 * (cb - 128) - 46802 * (cr - 128) + 32768, 65536)),
        clamp(y + floor_div(116130 * (cb - 128) + 32768, 65536))]

int[][] split_planes(int[][] pixels)
    converted := [for pixel := pixels[] then to_ycbcr(pixel)]
    return [for k := (0:<3)[] then [for pixel := converted[] then pixel[k]]]

int[][] component_planes(int[][] planes, int width, int height, int[][] factors, int mx, int my)
    hmax := factors[0][0]
    vmax := factors[0][1]
    int[][] result := []
    for: k < 3
        horizontal := factors[k][0]
        vertical := factors[k][1]
        fx := hmax / horizontal
        fy := vmax / vertical
        int[] component := []
        for: y < 8 * vertical * my
            for: x < 8 * horizontal * mx
                sum := 0
                for: j < fy
                    for: i < fx
                        original_x := fx * x + i
                        original_y := fy * y + j
                        if original_x >= width
                            original_x = width - 1
                        if original_y >= height
                            original_y = height - 1
                        sum += planes[k][original_y * width + original_x]
                component = component.append(sum / (fx * fy))
        result = result.append(component)
    return result

int[][] upsample(int[][] planes, int[][] factors, int mx, int width, int height)
    hmax := factors[0][0]
    vmax := factors[0][1]
    int[][] result := []
    for: k < 3
        horizontal := factors[k][0]
        vertical := factors[k][1]
        plane_width := 8 * horizontal * mx
        int[] values := []
        for: y < height
            for: x < width
                values = values.append(planes[k][(y * vertical / vmax) * plane_width + x * horizontal / hmax])
        result = result.append(values)
    return result

int[][] combine_rgb(int[][] planes)
    return [for p := (0:<int(#planes[0]))[] then to_rgb(planes[0][p], planes[1][p], planes[2][p])]

int floor_div(int numerator, int denominator)
    quotient := numerator / denominator
    if numerator < 0 and numerator % denominator != 0
        quotient -= 1
    return quotient

int clamp(int value)
    return if value < 0 then 0 elif value > 255 then 255 else value

int[] positions()
    return [0, 1, 8, 16, 9, 2, 3, 10, 17, 24, 32, 25, 18, 11, 4, 5, 12, 19, 26, 33, 40, 48, 41, 34, 27, 20, 13, 6, 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, 49, 56, 57, 50, 43, 36, 29, 22, 15, 23, 30, 37, 44, 51, 58, 59, 52, 45, 38, 31, 39, 46, 53, 60, 61, 54, 47, 55, 62, 63]

int rounded_shift(int value, int shift)
    return floor_div(value + 2 ^ (shift - 1), 2 ^ shift)

int[] forward(int[] block, int[][] transform)
    intermediate := [for u := (0:<8)[] then [for x := (0:<8)[] then 0]]
    for: u < 8
        for: x < 8
            sum := 0
            for: y < 8
                sum += transform[u][y] * (block[8 * y + x] - 128)
            intermediate[u][x] = rounded_shift(sum, 11)
    int[] result := []
    for: u < 8
        for: v < 8
            sum := 0
            for: x < 8
                sum += intermediate[u][x] * transform[v][x]
            result = result.append(rounded_shift(sum, 15))
    return result

int[] inverse(int[] coefficients, int[][] transform)
    intermediate := [for y := (0:<8)[] then [for v := (0:<8)[] then 0]]
    for: y < 8
        for: v < 8
            sum := 0
            for: u < 8
                sum += transform[u][y] * coefficients[8 * u + v]
            intermediate[y][v] = rounded_shift(sum, 11)
    int[] result := []
    for: y < 8
        for: x < 8
            sum := 0
            for: v < 8
                sum += intermediate[y][v] * transform[v][x]
            result = result.append(clamp(rounded_shift(sum, 15) + 128))
    return result

int[][] quantization_tables(int[][] basic, int quality)
    scale := if quality < 50 then 5000 / quality else 200 - 2 * quality
    int[][] result := []
    for table := basic[]
        int[] values := []
        for value := table[]
            quantized := (value * scale + 50) / 100
            values = values.append(if quantized < 1 then 1 elif quantized > 255 then 255 else quantized)
        result = result.append(values)
    return result

int[] quantize(int[] values, int[] table)
    int[] result := []
    for: i < 64
        magnitude := if values[i] < 0 then -values[i] else values[i]
        rounded := (magnitude + table[i] / 2) / table[i]
        result = result.append(if values[i] < 0 then -rounded else rounded)
    return result

int[] zigzag(int[] values)
    return [for position := positions()[] then values[position]]

int[] dequantize(int[] sequence, int[] table, keep := 64)
    result := [for i := (0:<64)[] then 0]
    zigzag_positions := positions()
    for: i < keep
        position := zigzag_positions[i]
        result[position] = sequence[i] * table[position]
    return result

int category(int value)
    magnitude := if value < 0 then -value else value
    size := 0
    while magnitude > 0
        magnitude /= 2
        size += 1
    return size

int[] extra_bits(int value)
    size := category(value)
    return [if value < 0 then value + 2 ^ size - 1 else value, size]

int amplitude(int bits, int size)
    if size == 0
        return 0
    return if bits >= 2 ^ (size - 1) then bits else bits - 2 ^ size + 1

class Table(int[] counts, int[] symbols)
    int[] lengths := [for i := (0:<256)[] then 0]
    int[] codes := [for i := (0:<256)[] then 0]
    code := 0
    offset := 0
    for: 1 <= length <= 16
        for: i < counts[length - 1]
            local symbol := symbols[offset]
            lengths[symbol] = length
            codes[symbol] = code
            code += 1
            offset += 1
        code *= 2

Table optimized_table(int[] frequencies)
    weights := frequencies.append(1)
    sizes := [for i := (0:<257)[] then 0]
    others := [for i := (0:<257)[] then -1]
    while true
        first := -1
        second := -1
        for: symbol <= 256
            if weights[symbol] <= 0
                continue
            if first < 0 or weights[symbol] <= weights[first]
                second = first
                first = symbol
            elif second < 0 or weights[symbol] <= weights[second]
                second = symbol
        if second < 0
            break
        weights[first] += weights[second]
        weights[second] = 0
        sizes[first] += 1
        while others[first] != -1
            first = others[first]
            sizes[first] += 1
        others[first] = second
        sizes[second] += 1
        while others[second] != -1
            second = others[second]
            sizes[second] += 1
    counts := [for i := (0:<257)[] then 0]
    longest := 0
    for size := sizes[]
        if size > 0
            counts[size] += 1
            if size > longest
                longest = size
    length := longest
    while length > 16
        while counts[length] > 0
            shorter := length - 2
            while counts[shorter] == 0
                shorter -= 1
            counts[length] -= 2
            counts[length - 1] += 1
            counts[shorter + 1] += 2
            counts[shorter] -= 1
        length -= 1
    length = 16
    while counts[length] == 0
        length -= 1
    counts[length] -= 1
    keys := [for symbol := (0:<256)[] if sizes[symbol] > 0 then sizes[symbol] * 256 + symbol]
    symbols := [for key := keys.sorted()[] then key % 256]
    return Table(counts[1:<17], symbols)

const hex_digits := "0123456789abcdef"

int integer(string text)
    value := int(text)
    return value

string[] lines(string path)
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    rows := text.split(NL)
    return rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1]

int[] integers(string row)
    return [for value := row.split(" ")[] then integer(value)]

class Image(int width, int height, int[][] pixels)
class Params(int[] qualities, string sampling, int restart_interval, string huffman_mode, int target_bytes, int generations, int[] truncate)
class Tables(int[][] transform, int[][] basic_quantization, int[][] counts, int[][] symbols)

Image read_ppm(string path)
    rows := lines(path)
    dimensions := integers(rows[1])
    int[][] pixels := []
    for row := rows[3:<int(#rows)][]
        values := integers(row)
        for: x < dimensions[0]
            pixels = pixels.append(values[3 * x:<3 * x + 3])
    return Image(dimensions[0], dimensions[1], pixels)

Params read_params()
    rows := [for row := lines("input/params.txt")[] then row.split(" ")]
    return Params([for value := rows[0][1:<int(#rows[0])][] then integer(value)], rows[1][1], integer(rows[2][1]), rows[3][1], integer(rows[4][1]), integer(rows[5][1]), [for value := rows[6][1:<int(#rows[6])][] then integer(value)])

Tables read_tables()
    rows := lines("input/tables.txt")
    transform := [for i := (1:<9)[] then integers(rows[i])]
    int[][] basic := []
    for start := [10, 19][]
        int[] values := []
        for: start <= i < start + 8
            values = values.concat(integers(rows[i]))
        basic = basic.append(values)
    counts := [for i := (28:37:3)[] then integers(rows[i])]
    symbols := [for i := (29:38:3)[] then integers(rows[i])]
    return Tables(transform, basic, counts, symbols)

int hex_value(string character)
    for: i < 16
        if character == hex_digits[i]
            return i
    return 0

string hex_byte(int value)
    byte := nat8(value)
    hex := byte.b16
    return "0" * (2 - #hex) + hex

int[] read_hex(string path)
    text := lines(path).join("")
    return [for i := (0:<int(#text):2)[] then 16 * hex_value(text[i]) + hex_value(text[i + 1])]

void write_lines(string name, string[] rows)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(rows.join(NL) + NL)

void write_ppm(string name, int width, int height, int[][] pixels)
    rows := ["P3", "{width} {height}", "255"]
    for: y < height
        string[] values := []
        for: x < width
            values = values.concat([for value := pixels[y * width + x][] then string(value)])
        rows = rows.append(values.join(" "))
    write_lines(name, rows)

void write_hex(string name, int[] bytes)
    string[] rows := []
    for: 0 <= start < int(#bytes) step 32
        end := if start + 32 < int(#bytes) then start + 32 else int(#bytes)
        rows = rows.append([for i := (int(start):<int(end))[] then hex_byte(bytes[i])].join(""))
    write_lines(name, rows)

import math
import image_io = "./image_io.qui"
import color = "./color.qui"
import dct = "./dct.qui"
import entropy = "./entropy.qui"
import bitstream = "./bitstream.qui"

int[] table_keys()
    return [0, 4, 1, 5]

string[] table_names()
    return ["dc_luma", "ac_luma", "dc_chroma", "ac_chroma"]

string[] component_names()
    return ["Y", "Cb", "Cr"]


int total(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

int maximum(int[] values)
    result := values[0]
    for value := values[]
        if value > result
            result = value
    return result

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

string integers_text(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then string(value)].join(" ")

int[] word(int value)
    return [value / 256, value % 256]

int read_word(int[] bytes, int offset)
    return 256 * bytes[offset] + bytes[offset + 1]

int[] segment(int marker, int[] contents)
    return [255, marker].concat(word(int(#contents) + 2)).concat(contents)

class Component(int identifier, int horizontal, int vertical, int quant_id, int dc_id, int ac_id)
class Block(int mcu, int component, int bx, int by)

Component[] standard_components(int horizontal, int vertical)
    return [Component(1, horizontal, vertical, 0, 0, 0), Component(2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1), Component(3, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1)]

class Layout(int width, int height, Component[] components, int restart_interval)
    int[][] factors := [for component := components[] then [component.horizontal, component.vertical]]
    int hmax := maximum([for component := components[] then component.horizontal])
    int vmax := maximum([for component := components[] then component.vertical])
    mx := (width + 8 * hmax - 1) / (8 * hmax)
    my := (height + 8 * vmax - 1) / (8 * vmax)
    mcus := mx * my
    int blocks_per_mcu := total([for component := components[] then component.horizontal * component.vertical])
    Block[] blocks := []
    for: mcu < mcus
        for: k < 3
            for: vertical < components[k].vertical
                for: horizontal < components[k].horizontal
                    local bx := components[k].horizontal * (mcu % mx) + horizontal
                    local by := components[k].vertical * (mcu / mx) + vertical
                    blocks = blocks.append(Block(mcu, k, bx, by))
    int step := if restart_interval == 0 then mcus else restart_interval
    int[][] intervals := []
    for: 0 <= first < mcus step step
        intervals = intervals.append([first, if first + step < mcus then step else mcus - first])

    int[] interval_blocks(int index)
        first := intervals[index][0] * blocks_per_mcu
        last := (intervals[index][0] + intervals[index][1]) * blocks_per_mcu
        return [for number := (int(first):<int(last))[] then number]

class Prepared(Layout layout, int[][] planes, int[][] quantization, int[][] coefficients)
class Symbol(int table_index, int value, int extra, int width)
class Symbols(Symbol[][] blocks, int[] differences, int[][] frequencies)
class Encoded(Prepared prepared, entropy.Table[] tables, int[][] frequencies, int[] differences, int[] block_bits, int[][] intervals, int[] bytes, int header_bytes, int scan_bytes, int padding_bits, int stuffed_bytes)
class Segment(int position, string name, int length)
class IntervalState(string status, string fault, int mcu, int offset, int resync)
class Parsed(Layout layout, int[][] quantization, entropy.Table[] tables, bool[] defined_tables, Segment[] segments, int scan_start, int scan_bytes)
class Decoded(Parsed parsed, int[][] coefficients, IntervalState[] states, int[][] planes, int[][] expanded, int[][] image)

entropy.Table[] empty_tables()
    return [for i := (0:<8)[] then entropy.Table([for j := (0:<16)[] then 0], [])]

entropy.Table[] standard_tables(image_io.Tables supplied)
    result := empty_tables()
    for: i < 4
        result[table_keys()[i]] = entropy.Table(supplied.counts[i], supplied.symbols[i])
    return result

Prepared prepare(int[][] image, int width, int height, int quality, string sampling, int restart_interval, image_io.Tables supplied)
    horizontal := if sampling == "444" then 1 else 2
    vertical := if sampling == "420" then 2 else 1
    layout := Layout(width, height, standard_components(horizontal, vertical), restart_interval)
    planes := color.component_planes(color.split_planes(image), width, height, layout.factors, layout.mx, layout.my)
    quantization := dct.quantization_tables(supplied.basic_quantization, quality)
    int[][] coefficients := []
    for block := layout.blocks[]
        component := layout.components[block.component]
        plane_width := 8 * component.horizontal * layout.mx
        int[] pixels := []
        for: y < 8
            for: x < 8
                pixels = pixels.append(planes[block.component][(8 * block.by + y) * plane_width + 8 * block.bx + x])
        transformed := dct.forward(pixels, supplied.transform)
        coefficients = coefficients.append(dct.zigzag(dct.quantize(transformed, quantization[component.quant_id])))
    return Prepared(layout, planes, quantization, coefficients)

Symbols build_symbols(Prepared prepared)
    layout := prepared.layout
    frequencies := [for i := (0:<8)[] then [for symbol := (0:<256)[] then 0]]
    Symbol[][] blocks := []
    int[] differences := []
    for: interval < int(#layout.intervals)
        predictors := [0, 0, 0]
        for number := layout.interval_blocks(interval)[]
            block := layout.blocks[number]
            component := layout.components[block.component]
            sequence := prepared.coefficients[number]
            difference := sequence[0] - predictors[block.component]
            predictors[block.component] = sequence[0]
            differences = differences.append(difference)
            extra := entropy.extra_bits(difference)
            symbols := [Symbol(component.dc_id, extra[1], extra[0], extra[1])]
            ac_table := 4 + component.ac_id
            zero_run := 0
            for: 1 <= index < 64
                value := sequence[index]
                if value == 0
                    zero_run += 1
                    continue
                while zero_run >= 16
                    symbols = symbols.append(Symbol(ac_table, 240, 0, 0))
                    zero_run -= 16
                extra = entropy.extra_bits(value)
                symbols = symbols.append(Symbol(ac_table, 16 * zero_run + extra[1], extra[0], extra[1]))
                zero_run = 0
            if zero_run > 0
                symbols = symbols.append(Symbol(ac_table, 0, 0, 0))
            for symbol := symbols[]
                frequencies[symbol.table_index][symbol.value] += 1
            blocks = blocks.append(symbols)
    return Symbols(blocks, differences, frequencies)

int[] header(Layout layout, int[][] quantization, entropy.Table[] tables)
    bytes := [255, 216]
    int[] contents := []
    for: identifier < 2
        contents = contents.append(identifier).concat(dct.zigzag(quantization[identifier]))
    bytes = bytes.concat(segment(219, contents))
    contents = [8].concat(word(layout.height)).concat(word(layout.width)).concat([3])
    for component := layout.components[]
        contents = contents.concat([component.identifier, 16 * component.horizontal + component.vertical, component.quant_id])
    bytes = bytes.concat(segment(192, contents))
    contents = []
    for key := table_keys()[]
        table := tables[key]
        contents = contents.append(16 * (key / 4) + key % 4).concat(table.counts).concat(table.symbols)
    bytes = bytes.concat(segment(196, contents))
    if layout.restart_interval > 0
        bytes = bytes.concat(segment(221, word(layout.restart_interval)))
    contents = [3]
    for component := layout.components[]
        contents = contents.concat([component.identifier, 16 * component.dc_id + component.ac_id])
    return bytes.concat(segment(218, contents.concat([0, 63, 0])))

Encoded encode_prepared(Prepared prepared, string mode, image_io.Tables supplied)
    symbols := build_symbols(prepared)
    tables := standard_tables(supplied)
    if mode == "optimized"
        for key := table_keys()[]
            tables[key] = entropy.optimized_table(symbols.frequencies[key])
    prefix := header(prepared.layout, prepared.quantization, tables)
    writer := bitstream.Writer()
    block_bits := [for i := (0:<int(#prepared.coefficients))[] then 0]
    int[][] intervals := []
    layout := prepared.layout
    for: interval < int(#layout.intervals)
        if interval > 0
            .writer.restart(interval - 1)
        start := int(#writer.bytes)
        for number := layout.interval_blocks(interval)[]
            for symbol := symbols.blocks[number][]
                table := tables[symbol.table_index]
                length := table.lengths[symbol.value]
                .writer.write(table.codes[symbol.value], length)
                .writer.write(symbol.extra, symbol.width)
                block_bits[number] += length + symbol.width
        .writer.pad()
        intervals = intervals.append([layout.intervals[interval][0], layout.intervals[interval][1], int(#prefix) + start, int(#writer.bytes) - start])
    int[] bytes := prefix.concat(writer.bytes).concat([255, 217])
    return Encoded(prepared, tables, symbols.frequencies, symbols.differences, block_bits, intervals, bytes, int(#prefix), int(#writer.bytes), writer.padding_bits, writer.stuffed_bytes)

Encoded encode(int[][] image, int width, int height, int quality, string sampling, string mode, int restart_interval, image_io.Tables supplied)
    return encode_prepared(prepare(image, width, height, quality, sampling, restart_interval, supplied), mode, supplied)

Parsed parse_header(int[] bytes)
    position := 2
    segments := [Segment(0, "SOI", 0)]
    int[][] quantization := [for i := (0:<4)[] then []]
    tables := empty_tables()
    defined_tables := [for i := (0:<8)[] then false]
    Component[] components := []
    restart_interval := 0
    width := 0
    height := 0
    while true
        marker := bytes[position + 1]
        length := read_word(bytes, position + 2)
        contents := bytes[position + 4:<position + length + 2]
        name := ""
        if marker >= 224 and marker <= 239
            name = "APP{marker - 224}"
        elif marker == 192
            name = "SOF0"
        elif marker == 196
            name = "DHT"
        elif marker == 219
            name = "DQT"
        elif marker == 221
            name = "DRI"
        elif marker == 218
            name = "SOS"
        else
            name = "COM"
        segments = segments.append(Segment(position, name, length))
        position += length + 2
        if marker == 219
            zigzag_positions := dct.positions()
            for: 0 <= offset < int(#contents) step 65
                table := [for i := (0:<64)[] then 0]
                for: i < 64
                    table[zigzag_positions[i]] = contents[offset + 1 + i]
                quantization[contents[offset]] = table
        elif marker == 196
            offset := 0
            while offset < int(#contents)
                key := 4 * (contents[offset] / 16) + contents[offset] % 16
                counts := contents[offset + 1:<offset + 17]
                symbol_count := total(counts)
                tables[key] = entropy.Table(counts, contents[offset + 17:<offset + 17 + symbol_count])
                defined_tables[key] = true
                offset += 17 + symbol_count
        elif marker == 192
            height = read_word(contents, 1)
            width = read_word(contents, 3)
            for: i < 3
                offset := 6 + 3 * i
                factors := contents[offset + 1]
                components = components.append(Component(contents[offset], factors / 16, factors % 16, contents[offset + 2], 0, 0))
        elif marker == 221
            restart_interval = read_word(contents, 0)
        elif marker == 218
            for: i < 3
                selectors := contents[2 + 2 * i]
                components[i].dc_id = selectors / 16
                components[i].ac_id = selectors % 16
            break
    segments = segments.append(Segment(int(#bytes) - 2, "EOI", 0))
    return Parsed(Layout(width, height, components, restart_interval), quantization, tables, defined_tables, segments, position, int(#bytes) - 2 - position)

int read_symbol(bitstream.Reader &reader, entropy.Table table)
    code := 0
    for: 1 <= length <= 16
        next := .reader.bit()
        if reader.fault != ""
            return -1
        code = 2 * code + next
        for symbol := table.symbols[]
            if table.lengths[symbol] == length and table.codes[symbol] == code
                return symbol
    reader.fault = "code"
    return -1

int[] decode_block(bitstream.Reader &reader, int component_index, Component component, entropy.Table[] tables, int[] &predictors)
    coefficients := [for i := (0:<64)[] then 0]
    size := read_symbol(&reader, tables[component.dc_id])
    if reader.fault != ""
        return []
    bits := .reader.read(size)
    if reader.fault != ""
        return []
    predictors[component_index] += entropy.amplitude(bits, size)
    coefficients[0] = predictors[component_index]
    index := 1
    while index <= 63
        symbol := read_symbol(&reader, tables[4 + component.ac_id])
        if reader.fault != ""
            return []
        if symbol == 0
            break
        zero_run := symbol / 16
        size = symbol % 16
        index += zero_run
        if index > 63
            reader.fault = "index"
            return []
        if size > 0
            bits = .reader.read(size)
            if reader.fault != ""
                return []
            coefficients[index] = entropy.amplitude(bits, size)
        index += 1
    return coefficients

int[] reconstruct_component(Layout layout, int component_index, int[][] coefficients, int[][] quantization, int[][] transform, keep := 64)
    component := layout.components[component_index]
    width := 8 * component.horizontal * layout.mx
    height := 8 * component.vertical * layout.my
    plane := [for p := (0:<int(width * height))[] then 128]
    for: number < int(#layout.blocks)
        block := layout.blocks[number]
        if block.component != component_index
            continue
        pixels := dct.inverse(dct.dequantize(coefficients[number], quantization[component.quant_id], keep), transform)
        for: y < 8
            for: x < 8
                plane[(8 * block.by + y) * width + 8 * block.bx + x] = pixels[8 * y + x]
    return plane

Decoded decode(int[] bytes, int[][] transform)
    parsed := parse_header(bytes)
    layout := parsed.layout
    coefficients := [for block := layout.blocks[] then [for i := (0:<64)[] then 0]]
    states := [for interval := layout.intervals[] then IntervalState("lost", "", 0, 0, 0)]
    reader := bitstream.Reader(bytes, parsed.scan_start)
    interval := 0
    while interval < int(#layout.intervals)
        predictors := [0, 0, 0]
        int[][] pending := []
        current_mcu := layout.intervals[interval][0]
        reader.fault = ""
        for number := layout.interval_blocks(interval)[]
            block := layout.blocks[number]
            current_mcu = block.mcu
            sequence := decode_block(&reader, block.component, layout.components[block.component], parsed.tables, &predictors)
            if reader.fault != ""
                break
            pending = pending.append(sequence)
        .reader.discard()
        if reader.fault == ""
            expected := if interval + 1 < int(#layout.intervals) then 208 + interval % 8 else 217
            if bytes[reader.position] != 255 or bytes[reader.position + 1] != expected
                reader.fault = "sync"
        if reader.fault == ""
            numbers := layout.interval_blocks(interval)
            for: i < int(#numbers)
                coefficients[numbers[i]] = pending[i]
            states[interval] = IntervalState("ok", "", 0, 0, 0)
            reader.position += 2
            interval += 1
        else
            offset := reader.position
            resync := bitstream.find_resync(bytes, offset)
            states[interval] = IntervalState("damaged", reader.fault, current_mcu, offset, resync)
            marker := bytes[resync + 1]
            if marker == 217
                break
            adjustment := (marker - 208 - interval) % 8
            if adjustment < 0
                adjustment += 8
            interval += 1 + adjustment
            reader.position = resync + 2
    planes := [for k := (0:<3)[] then reconstruct_component(layout, k, coefficients, parsed.quantization, transform)]
    expanded := color.upsample(planes, layout.factors, layout.mx, layout.width, layout.height)
    return Decoded(parsed, coefficients, states, planes, expanded, color.combine_rgb(expanded))

Encoded repair(Decoded decoded, image_io.Tables supplied)
    source := decoded.parsed.layout
    first := source.components[0]
    layout := Layout(source.width, source.height, standard_components(first.horizontal, first.vertical), source.restart_interval)
    quantization := [decoded.parsed.quantization[first.quant_id], decoded.parsed.quantization[source.components[1].quant_id]]
    return encode_prepared(Prepared(layout, [], quantization, decoded.coefficients), "optimized", supplied)

int[] image_values(int[][] image)
    int[] values := []
    for pixel := image[]
        values = values.concat(pixel)
    return values

string psnr(int[] first, int[] second)
    squared_error := 0
    for: i < int(#first)
        difference := first[i] - second[i]
        squared_error += difference * difference
    if squared_error == 0
        return "inf"
    logarithm := math.log(real64(65025 * int(#first)) / real64(squared_error))
    value := 10.0 * logarithm / 2.302585092994046
    rounded := math.floor(value * 100.0 + 0.5)
    fraction := string(rounded % 100)
    return string(rounded / 100) + "." + (if #fraction == 1 then "0" else "") + fraction

string image_psnr(int[][] first, int[][] second)
    return psnr(image_values(first), image_values(second))

class Quality(string[] scores, int max_error)

Quality quality_metrics(int[][] original, int[][] original_planes, Decoded decoded)
    scores := [for k := (0:<3)[] then psnr(original_planes[k], decoded.expanded[k])]
    scores = scores.append(image_psnr(original, decoded.image))
    max_error := 0
    for: pixel < int(#original)
        for: channel < 3
            difference := absolute(original[pixel][channel] - decoded.image[pixel][channel])
            if difference > max_error
                max_error = difference
    return Quality(scores, max_error)

int gcd(int first, int second)
    a := first
    b := second
    while b != 0
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

string bits_per_pixel(int bytes, int width, int height)
    numerator := 8 * bytes
    denominator := width * height
    divisor := gcd(numerator, denominator)
    return "{numerator / divisor}/{denominator / divisor}"

class BlockStats(string[] lines, int[] squared_errors)

BlockStats block_statistics(Encoded encoded, Decoded decoded)
    layout := encoded.prepared.layout
    lines := ["blocks {#layout.blocks}"]
    int[] squared_errors := []
    for: number < int(#layout.blocks)
        block := layout.blocks[number]
        component := layout.components[block.component]
        plane_width := 8 * component.horizontal * layout.mx
        squared_error := 0
        for: y < 8
            for: x < 8
                pixel := (8 * block.by + y) * plane_width + 8 * block.bx + x
                difference := encoded.prepared.planes[block.component][pixel] - decoded.planes[block.component][pixel]
                squared_error += difference * difference
        squared_errors = squared_errors.append(squared_error)
        sequence := encoded.prepared.coefficients[number]
        nonzero := 0
        last := 0
        for: 1 <= i < 64
            if sequence[i] != 0
                nonzero += 1
                last = i
        lines = lines.append("block {number} {component_names()[block.component]} {block.bx} {block.by} dc {sequence[0]} diff {encoded.differences[number]} nonzero {nonzero} last {last} bits {encoded.block_bits[number]} sse {squared_error}")
    return BlockStats(lines, squared_errors)

string binary_text(int code, int width)
    result := ""
    shift := width - 1
    while shift >= 0
        result += string((code / (2 ^ shift)) % 2)
        shift -= 1
    return result

string[] huffman_lines(Encoded encoded)
    string[] lines := []
    for: i < 4
        key := table_keys()[i]
        table := encoded.tables[key]
        frequencies := encoded.frequencies[key]
        bits := total([for symbol := table.symbols[] then frequencies[symbol] * table.lengths[symbol]])
        lines = lines.concat(["table {table_names()[i]} class {key / 4} id {key % 4} symbols {#table.symbols} coded {total(frequencies)} bits {bits}", "counts " + integers_text(table.counts)])
        for symbol := table.symbols[]
            length := table.lengths[symbol]
            lines = lines.append("symbol " + image_io.hex_byte(symbol) + " length {length} code " + binary_text(table.codes[symbol], length) + " count {frequencies[symbol]}")
    return lines

int[][] thumbnail(Decoded decoded)
    layout := decoded.parsed.layout
    width := (layout.width + 7) / 8
    height := (layout.height + 7) / 8
    int[][] image := []
    for: y < height
        for: x < width
            int[] values := []
            for: k < 3
                component := layout.components[k]
                bx := x * component.horizontal / layout.hmax
                by := y * component.vertical / layout.vmax
                dc := 0
                for: number < int(#layout.blocks)
                    block := layout.blocks[number]
                    if block.component == k and block.bx == bx and block.by == by
                        dc = decoded.coefficients[number][0]
                        break
                divisor := decoded.parsed.quantization[component.quant_id][0]
                values = values.append(color.clamp(color.floor_div(dc * divisor + 4, 8) + 128))
            image = image.append(color.to_rgb(values[0], values[1], values[2]))
    return image

string[] stream_report(Decoded decoded, Encoded repaired, Decoded repaired_decoded)
    parsed := decoded.parsed
    layout := parsed.layout
    lines := [for entry := parsed.segments[] then "stream_segment {entry.position} {entry.name} {entry.length}"]
    lines = lines.append("stream_image {layout.width} {layout.height}")
    for component := layout.components[]
        lines = lines.append("stream_component {component.identifier} {component.horizontal} {component.vertical} {component.quant_id} {component.dc_id} {component.ac_id}")
    for: identifier < 4
        if #parsed.quantization[identifier] != 0
            lines = lines.append("stream_quant {identifier} " + integers_text(dct.zigzag(parsed.quantization[identifier])))
    for: key < 8
        if parsed.defined_tables[key]
            table := parsed.tables[key]
            longest := 0
            for: 1 <= length <= 16
                if table.counts[length - 1] > 0
                    longest = length
            lines = lines.append("stream_huffman {key / 4} {key % 4} symbols {#table.symbols} longest {longest}")
    counts := [0, 0, 0]
    statuses := ["ok", "damaged", "lost"]
    for state := decoded.states[]
        for: i < 3
            if state.status == statuses[i]
                counts[i] += 1
    lines = lines.append("stream_restart {layout.restart_interval} intervals {#layout.intervals} ok {counts[0]} damaged {counts[1]} lost {counts[2]}")
    for: i < int(#layout.intervals)
        state := decoded.states[i]
        description := state.status
        if state.status == "damaged"
            description += " {state.fault} mcu {state.mcu} offset {state.offset} resync {state.resync}"
        lines = lines.append("stream_interval {i} {layout.intervals[i][0]} {layout.intervals[i][1]} {description}")
    identical := if decoded.image == repaired_decoded.image then "yes" else "no"
    return lines.concat(["stream_scan_bytes {parsed.scan_bytes}", "repair {#repaired.bytes} {repaired.header_bytes} {repaired.scan_bytes} identical {identical}"])

class Experiment(image_io.Image input_image, image_io.Params params, image_io.Tables supplied, int[] stream)
    int width := input_image.width
    int height := input_image.height
    int[][] image := input_image.pixels
    int[][] original_planes := color.split_planes(image)
    int quality := params.qualities[0]
    Encoded reference := encode(image, width, height, quality, params.sampling, params.huffman_mode, params.restart_interval, supplied)
    Decoded reference_decoded := decode(reference.bytes, supplied.transform)

    Encoded encoding(int requested_quality, string requested_sampling, string requested_mode)
        return encode(image, width, height, requested_quality, requested_sampling, requested_mode, params.restart_interval, supplied)

    string[] rate_distortion()
        lines := ["quality,bytes_standard,bytes_optimized,bpp,psnr_y,psnr_cb,psnr_cr,psnr_rgb,max_error"]
        for requested_quality := params.qualities[]
            prepared := prepare(image, width, height, requested_quality, params.sampling, params.restart_interval, supplied)
            standard := encode_prepared(prepared, "standard", supplied)
            optimized := encode_prepared(prepared, "optimized", supplied)
            selected := if params.huffman_mode == "standard" then standard else optimized
            measured := quality_metrics(image, original_planes, decode(selected.bytes, supplied.transform))
            values := [string(requested_quality), string(#standard.bytes), string(#optimized.bytes), bits_per_pixel(int(#selected.bytes), width, height)]
            lines = lines.append(values.concat(measured.scores).append(string(measured.max_error)).join(","))
        return lines

    string[] reference_report(int[] squared_errors)
        layout := reference.prepared.layout
        counts := [for component := layout.components[] then component.horizontal * component.vertical * layout.mcus]
        lines := ["image {width} {height}", "sampling {params.sampling} mcu {8 * layout.hmax} {8 * layout.vmax} grid {layout.mx} {layout.my}",
            "padded {8 * layout.hmax * layout.mx} {8 * layout.vmax * layout.my}", "blocks " + integers_text(counts),
            "restart_interval {params.restart_interval} markers {int(#layout.intervals) - 1}", "huffman {params.huffman_mode}", "quality {quality}"]
        for: identifier < 2
            lines = lines.append("quant {identifier} " + integers_text(dct.zigzag(reference.prepared.quantization[identifier])))
        lines = lines.append("symbols " + integers_text([for key := table_keys()[] then total(reference.frequencies[key])]))
        eob := reference.frequencies[4][0] + reference.frequencies[5][0]
        zrl := reference.frequencies[4][240] + reference.frequencies[5][240]
        zero_ac := 0
        nonzero := [for i := (0:<64)[] then 0]
        for sequence := reference.prepared.coefficients[]
            any_ac := false
            for: i < 64
                if sequence[i] != 0
                    nonzero[i] += 1
                    if i != 0
                        any_ac = true
            if not any_ac
                zero_ac += 1
        lines = lines.concat(["eob {eob} zrl {zrl}", "zero_ac_blocks {zero_ac}", "nonzero " + integers_text(nonzero)])
        for: k < 3
            bits := 0
            count := 0
            squared_error := 0
            for: number < int(#layout.blocks)
                if layout.blocks[number].component != k
                    continue
                bits += reference.block_bits[number]
                squared_error += squared_errors[number]
                for value := reference.prepared.coefficients[number][]
                    if value != 0
                        count += 1
            lines = lines.append("component {component_names()[k]} bits {bits} nonzero {count} sse {squared_error}")
        lines = lines.concat(["padding_bits {reference.padding_bits}", "stuffed_bytes {reference.stuffed_bytes}", "header_bytes {reference.header_bytes}", "scan_bytes {reference.scan_bytes}", "total_bytes {#reference.bytes}"])
        for: i < int(#reference.intervals)
            interval := reference.intervals[i]
            lines = lines.append("interval {i} {interval[0]} {interval[1]} {interval[2]} {interval[3]}")
        histogram := [for i := (0:<8)[] then 0]
        boundaries := [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64]
        for: pixel < width * height
            for: channel < 3
                difference := absolute(image[pixel][channel] - reference_decoded.image[pixel][channel])
                bin_index := 0
                while bin_index < 7 and difference >= boundaries[bin_index]
                    bin_index += 1
                histogram[bin_index] += 1
        lines = lines.append("error_histogram " + integers_text(histogram))
        for keep := params.truncate[]
            plane := reconstruct_component(layout, 0, reference_decoded.coefficients, reference_decoded.parsed.quantization, supplied.transform, keep)
            plane_width := 8 * layout.components[0].horizontal * layout.mx
            int[] cropped := []
            for: y < height
                cropped = cropped.concat(plane[y * plane_width:<y * plane_width + width])
            lines = lines.append("truncate {keep} " + psnr(original_planes[0], cropped))
        return lines

    string[] sampling_comparison()
        string[] lines := []
        for sampling := ["444", "422", "420"][]
            Encoded encoded := encoding(quality, sampling, params.huffman_mode)
            measured := quality_metrics(image, original_planes, decode(encoded.bytes, supplied.transform))
            lines = lines.append("sampling_compare {sampling} {#encoded.bytes} " + measured.scores[1:<4].join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] generation_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        previous := image
        for: 1 <= generation <= params.generations
            encoded := if generation == 1 then reference else encode(previous, width, height, quality, params.sampling, params.huffman_mode, params.restart_interval, supplied)
            decoded := if generation == 1 then reference_decoded else decode(encoded.bytes, supplied.transform)
            changed := 0
            for: pixel < width * height
                if previous[pixel] != decoded.image[pixel]
                    changed += 1
            lines = lines.append("generation {generation} {#encoded.bytes} " + image_psnr(image, decoded.image) + " {changed}")
            previous = decoded.image
        return lines

    string[] quality_search()
        lower := 1
        upper := 100
        string[] lines := []
        while lower < upper
            middle := (lower + upper + 1) / 2
            Encoded encoded := encoding(middle, params.sampling, params.huffman_mode)
            size := int(#encoded.bytes)
            lines = lines.append("rate_control_step {middle} {size}")
            if size <= params.target_bytes
                lower = middle
            else
                upper = middle - 1
        Encoded encoded := encoding(lower, params.sampling, params.huffman_mode)
        fits := if int(#encoded.bytes) <= params.target_bytes then "yes" else "no"
        value := image_psnr(image, decode(encoded.bytes, supplied.transform).image)
        return lines.append("rate_control {lower} {#encoded.bytes} {fits} {value}")

    void write_outputs()
        statistics := block_statistics(reference, reference_decoded)
        string[] report := reference_report(statistics.squared_errors).concat(sampling_comparison()).concat(generation_lines()).concat(quality_search())
        stream_decoded := decode(stream, supplied.transform)
        repaired := repair(stream_decoded, supplied)
        repaired_decoded := decode(repaired.bytes, supplied.transform)
        report = report.concat(stream_report(stream_decoded, repaired, repaired_decoded))
        image_io.write_lines("rate_distortion.csv", rate_distortion())
        image_io.write_ppm("decoded.ppm", width, height, reference_decoded.image)
        image_io.write_hex("bitstream.hex", reference.bytes)
        image_io.write_ppm("thumbnail.ppm", (width + 7) / 8, (height + 7) / 8, thumbnail(reference_decoded))
        image_io.write_lines("huffman_tables.txt", huffman_lines(reference))
        image_io.write_lines("blocks.txt", statistics.lines)
        image_io.write_ppm("stream_decoded.ppm", stream_decoded.parsed.layout.width, stream_decoded.parsed.layout.height, stream_decoded.image)
        image_io.write_hex("repaired.hex", repaired.bytes)
        image_io.write_lines("report.txt", report)

void run()
    experiment := Experiment(image_io.read_ppm("input/image.ppm"), image_io.read_params(), image_io.read_tables(), image_io.read_hex("input/stream.hex"))
    experiment.write_outputs()

run()
